task_goal: Land the spacecraft on the landing pad at (0,0) as fast as possible with minimal fuel consumption.
reward_function_interface: def compute_reward(state, m_power, s_power, terminated) -> (float, dict)
state_space: 8-dimensional vector: [x, y, vx, vy, angle, angular_velocity, leg1_contact, leg2_contact]
action_space: Discrete: 0 (do nothing), 1 (fire left orientation engine), 2 (fire main engine), 3 (fire right orientation engine)
success_like_ending: Both legs ground contact (state[6]==1 and state[7]==1).
Lander is awake and not crashed.
behavior_trajectory_prior: Phase 1: Descent and horizontal alignment - use main engine (action 2) to control descent rate and orientation engines (actions 1,3) to center over pad.
Phase 2: Final approach - reduce vertical speed, maintain upright angle, both legs contact pad simultaneously.
Phase 3: Landing - zero velocity, upright angle, both legs grounded, terminate with success.
reward_design_risks: Hovering indefinitely at high altitude using main engine (wastes fuel, no progress).
Landing far from pad (outside pad) but not crashing - satisfies 'not crash' but misses primary objective.
Excessive use of orientation engines causing oscillation or wasted fuel.
Landing with high vertical velocity but both legs contact - may be unstable.
